title: Membership plans
text: Larkspur Cycles offers three plans: Day Pass, Monthly, and Annual. Monthly and Annual members get unlimited 45-minute rides; longer rides cost extra per 15 minutes.

title: Cancel or pause your membership
text: You can end a Monthly or Annual plan at any time from Account > Plan. Cancellation takes effect at the end of the current billing period. Annual members can also pause for up to two months a year.

title: Refunds and disputed charges
text: If you were billed twice for the same ride or charged for a ride you did not take, open the ride in your history and tap Report a charge. Approved refunds return to the original card within 5 to 10 business days.

title: Why did my ride cost extra?
text: Rides longer than your plan's included time are billed in 15-minute increments. Docking at a full station does not stop the clock; use the app to request a free 15-minute grace period.

title: Unlocking a bike
text: Scan the QR code on the handlebars with the app, or enter the five-digit bike number. The lock opens with two short beeps. If nothing happens after ten seconds, try another bike.

title: Error E-417: dock did not release the bike
text: E-417 means the dock received your unlock request but its latch failed. Wait thirty seconds and retry once. If the error repeats, choose a different dock; you are not charged for failed unlocks.

title: Error E-416: payment method declined
text: E-416 appears when your card is declined at unlock. Update your payment method under Account > Wallet, then try again. Prepaid and some virtual cards are not accepted.

title: Ending a ride
text: Push the bike firmly into any open dock until the light turns green. Your ride ends when the dock confirms the lock. Check the app for the ride receipt to be sure.

title: What to do when a station is full
text: If every dock at a station is taken, open the app map to find the nearest station with open docks, or tap Station full to get 15 extra minutes at no cost.

title: E-bike battery and range
text: Electric bikes show battery level on the handlebar display and in the app. A full battery covers roughly 40 kilometers. E-bikes below 20 percent are hidden from the map.

title: Reporting a damaged bike
text: If a bike has a flat tire, loose seat, broken bell, or faulty brakes, dock it and press the wrench button on the dock, or report it in the app. Do not ride a bike with brake problems.

title: If you are in a crash
text: Make sure you and others are safe and call emergency services if anyone is hurt. Then report the incident in the app within 24 hours so our safety team can follow up.

title: Lost and found
text: Left something in a bike basket? Contact support with the bike number and ride time. Items found by our field team are held for 30 days at the central depot.

title: Student and income-based discounts
text: Students with a valid university email and residents enrolled in qualifying assistance programs can get the Annual plan at a reduced price. Apply under Account > Discounts.

title: Larkspur for Business
text: Companies can buy memberships in bulk for employees and receive a single monthly invoice. Administrators manage seats from the business dashboard.

title: Receipts and invoices
text: Every ride and plan payment generates a receipt in Account > History. You can download a monthly PDF statement for expense reports.

title: Can't sign in
text: Use Forgot password on the sign-in screen to receive a reset link by email. If you signed up with your phone number, request a one-time code by text message instead.

title: Service area and stations
text: Larkspur operates 320 stations across the city center and the riverside districts. Riding outside the service area is allowed, but bikes must be returned to a station.

title: Helmets and safe riding
text: We recommend wearing a helmet on every ride. Riders must be at least 16 years old. Follow local traffic laws and use bike lanes where available.

title: Winter and weather closures
text: During snow or ice storms we may close stations temporarily. Closed stations appear grey on the map, and rides in progress can still be ended at any open dock.
